stories.title: Panther’s Rage
stories.why: A foundational Wakandan saga and the introduction of Killmonger.
stories.match: Marvel Masterworks: The Black Panther Vol. 1 collects Jungle Action #6–24, including Panther’s Rage. The #6–24 in the catalog title is Jungle Action numbering.

stories.title: The Client & Enemy of the State
stories.why: Priest’s opening establishes a politically sharp, strategically minded T’Challa.
stories.match: Complete Collection Vol. 1 covers #1–17; it contains these opening arcs.

stories.title: Who Is the Black Panther?
stories.why: Hudlin and Romita Jr. offer an approachable reintroduction to Wakanda.
stories.match: Matched by exact ISBN and collection title in the supplied catalog. Open the library record to check borrowing.

stories.title: See Wakanda and Die
stories.why: A concentrated showcase of Wakanda during Secret Invasion.
stories.match: Secret Invasion: Black Panther collects the exact #39–41 story. This is not the main Secret Invasion event book.

stories.title: A Nation Under Our Feet
stories.why: Coates begins with questions of power, monarchy and Wakanda’s people.
stories.match: This full twelve-issue collection overlaps the three shorter A Nation Under Our Feet books.
